scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run db:push --workspace backend && npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.start:remote: npm run build --workspace backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build --workspace frontend && cross-env REMOTE_TESTING=true node backend/dist/index.js
scripts.verify:ci: npm run typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.node.json && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build:pages --workspace frontend && npm --ignore-scripts test --workspaces && npm --ignore-scripts run test:database --workspace backend && npm --ignore-scripts run test:auth --workspace backend && npm --ignore-scripts run test:stripe --workspace backend
